# Test fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic and anonymized. Their structure mirrors real data observed in Phase 0 (VS Code 1.145.2, Copilot CLI 1.0.95–1.0.103), but **every string value is placeholder text**: there is no real prompt, response, path, repository or secret. They are generated by [`spikes/make-fixtures.mjs`](../../../spikes/make-fixtures.mjs); regenerate them with `spikes/node.sh spikes/make-fixtures.mjs`.

The layout mirrors the real roots, so discovery code can point at `vscode/` (a VS Code `User/` dir) and `cli/session-state/` (`~/.copilot/session-state`).

| Path | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `vscode/workspaceStorage/a1b2…8f90/workspace.json` | `{ "folder": "file:///home/user/projects/sample-app" }` |
| `vscode/workspaceStorage/a1b2…8f90/chatSessions/1111….jsonl` | Main `.jsonl` replay fixture (details below) |
| `vscode/workspaceStorage/a1b2…8f90/chatSessions/2222….json` | Legacy full-JSON session (R4.5): 1 request, `inputState.mode.id = ask` |
| `vscode/workspaceStorage/b2c3…90a1/workspace.json` | `{ "workspace": "file:///…/sample-app.code-workspace" }` |
| `vscode/workspaceStorage/b2c3…90a1/chatSessions/1111….jsonl` | **Byte-identical copy** of session `1111…` (same id in two workspaces, see `spikes/S2-index-engine.md`, finding 3) |
| `vscode/globalStorage/emptyWindowChatSessions/3333….jsonl` | Empty-window session, 1 turn |
| `cli/session-state/4444…/events.jsonl` + `workspace.yaml` | Copilot CLI session (details below) |
| `cli/session-state/4444…/inuse.12345.lock` | Lock file of a session in use (R3.5: read anyway) |

## `1111….jsonl` (VS Code mutation log)

- Line kinds: one `kind 0`, twelve `kind 1` (two of them are **prototype-pollution** attempts, `["__proto__",…]` and `[…,"constructor","prototype",…]`, R4.3) and twelve `kind 2` lines, plus an **unknown `kind 7`** line (R4.4). The **last line is truncated** and should be counted as malformed.
- Response parts: `mcpServersStarting`, `thinking`, `toolInvocationSerialized` ×2 (one with `resultDetails` output and one with `toolSpecificData.commandLine`), markdown (no `kind`), `inlineReference`, `codeblockUri`, `textEditGroup` and `undoStop`.
- Attachment and tool-output placeholders contain the text `must never be indexed` (R4.8, R4.9). Tests can assert that this text is never searchable.
- There is an image variable with base64 PNG bytes (`stripImageData`).

| Turn | Prompt | Expected mapping |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | refactor `parseJsonLine` … `Členů` | tools `copilot_readFile`, `run_in_terminal`; files `src/parser.ts`, `src/parser-utils.ts`; model `copilot/claude-sonnet-5.5`; mode `Agent`; tokens 12 000 / 800; credits 1; elapsedMs 4 200 |
| 1 | `continue` | **noise**, **canceled** (`modelState.value = 2`) |
| 2 | todo summary | **hidden** (`isSystemInitiated`, `hiddenFromTranscript`) |

Session title: `customTitle` = `Sample parser refactoring`.

## CLI session `4444…`

| Turn | Prompt | Expected mapping |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Add a unit test for `parseJsonLine` | tools `view`, `create`; files `src/parser.ts` (attachment), `test/parser.test.ts` (`fileEdits`). The sub-agent `user.message` (with `agentId`) does **not** start a turn, and sub-agent output is excluded from the response. Tokens are Σ `usage_record`: 21 500 / 450; credits (1.5 + 0.5 + 1.6)e9 nanoAiu = 3.6; elapsedMs 12 000 |
| 1 | Now run the tests | mode `autopilot`; tool `bash`; **canceled** (`abort`); no response |
| 2 | `continue` | **hidden** (`isAutopilotContinuation`); model `gpt-6.1-sol` (after `session.model_change`); credits 0.7 |

Workspace (from `workspace.yaml`): `git_root` = `cwd` = `/home/user/projects/sample-app`, repository `sample-org/sample-app`, title `name: Sample CLI session`. The file also contains ignored events (`system.message`, `hook.start`, `session.binary_asset`, `session.shutdown`).
